title: Zips, maɓalli da rufewa waɗanda ke aiki kowane lokaci

say: Zips, maɓalli da rufewa waɗanda ke aiki kowane lokaci.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module uku na Ƙarshen Kayayyakin Kaya da Kula da Inganci.
Rufewa sashi ne mai motsi. Ana buɗewa kuma an rufe shi ɗaruruwan lokuta.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Rufewa sashi ne mai motsi

zips na yau da kullun don ƙarfi

say: Wannan tsarin ya ƙunshi zik ɗin da ba a iya gani don riguna masu dacewa, zips na yau da kullun inda ƙarfin ƙarfin, da maɓalli da ƙugiya waɗanda suka wuce.

say: Zip ɗin da ba a iya gani yana kama da kabu na yau da kullun, tare da tab ɗin ja kawai yana nunawa. Saya shi aƙalla 2 zuwa 3 cm ya fi tsayi fiye da buɗewa. Kuma kar a dinka dinka a kasa tukuna. zip na shiga farko.

panel.heading: Ki shirya kafin kiyi dinki
items: Saya shi 2 zuwa 3 cm ya fi tsayi fiye da budewa
Bar dinkin da ke ƙasa maras dinki
Ƙare gefuna na izinin kabu
Fuse tsiri na 2 cm na tsaka-tsakin haske
Danna coil daga gefen da ba daidai ba

say: Ƙare gefuna na ba da izini, sa'an nan kuma haɗa wani tsiri na tsaka-tsakin haske, kimanin 2 cm fadi, inda zip ɗin zai tafi.

say: Bude zip ɗin kuma danna coil daga tef ɗin daga gefen da bai dace ba, akan ƙaramin saitin roba ba tare da tururi ba. Kar a bar ƙarfe ya taɓa nada.

panel.heading: Ki shirya kafin kiyi dinki
items: Saya shi 2 zuwa 3 cm ya fi tsayi fiye da budewa

Ƙare gefuna na izinin kabu
Fuse tsiri na 2 cm na tsaka-tsakin haske
Danna coil daga gefen da ba daidai ba
panel.rule: Danna coil tare da ƙaramin ƙarfe kuma babu tururi. Kar a taɓa murɗa.

say: Sanya fuskar zip ɗin da aka buɗe a gefen dama na yanki na hagu, murɗa daidai akan layin dinki. Yi amfani da ƙafar zip ɗin da ba a iya gani, kuma ɗinka daga sama zuwa ƙasa har sai ƙafar ta taɓa madaidaicin.

panel.heading: Dinka zip ɗin da ba a iya gani
items: Gefen farko: nada akan layin dinki
Dinka sama zuwa ƙasa har sai ƙafar ta haɗu da silima
Rufe shi kuma yi alama a kan tef
Bangare na biyu: alamomin wasa, sama zuwa ƙasa
Rufe dunƙulen da ke ƙasa, mai haɗawa da 1 cm

say: Rufe zip ɗin kuma alli matsayin kubu a kan tef na biyu. Misali, Tolu da ke Ilorin ta yi daidai da ƙugunta a cikin 1 mm ta haka. Dinka gefe na biyu, shima daga sama zuwa kasa.

panel.rule: dinka bangarorin biyu daga sama zuwa kasa, don haka zip din ba zai iya karkata ba.

say: Tare da ƙafar zip na yau da kullun, fara suturar da ke ƙasa kamar 1 cm sama da ƙarshen ɗinkin zip ɗin kuma kusan 2 mm zuwa hagu, don haka layin suna ɗan ɗanɗana ba tare da taɓa nada ba.

say: Kumfa a ƙasa yana nufin ɗinkin da ke ƙasa ya fara nisa da ɗinkin zip ɗin.

panel.heading: Laifin zip guda uku da dalilansu

cards.d: Dankin da ke ƙasa ya fara nisa da ɗinkin zip ɗin.
Ba a matse nada lebur ba, ko ƙafar ta yi nisa daga nada.
Ba a daidaita alawus ɗin ɗinki tare da haɗin gwiwa ba.

say: Tef ɗin zip ɗin da ake gani yana nufin ba'a matse coil ɗin lebur ba, ko ƙafar ta tafi daga gare ta.

say: Waving yana nufin ba a daidaita alawus ɗin ba. Gyara sanadin kafin ku sake sakewa.

say: zips na yau da kullun, tare da hakora a gaba, sun fi ƙarfi da sauƙin gyarawa. A cikin saitin latse, ninka guda ɗaya yana ɓoye haƙora da kuma layi ɗaya na saman.

right: Yayi kama da kabu na yau da kullun

say: Siffofin da ba a ganuwa suna kama da kabu na yau da kullun, mafi kyau don dacewa da lalacewa na lokaci, amma ba su da ƙarfi.

say: Misali, Ruth a Kaduna tana dinka zip din tsakiya a cikin siket din auduga na ruwa. Ta zaɓi 7 mm a kowane gefen kabu, don haka layuka biyu sun faɗi akan tef ɗin zip, ba tare da haƙora ba. Tafiyar kaset ɗin abin rufe fuska mai tsawon mm 7 yana jagoranta.

panel.heading: Ruth ta tsakiya zip, lafiya
items: Topstitch 7 mm kowane gefen kabu
Masking tef tsiri a matsayin jagora
Ketare 1 cm ƙasa da tashar zip
Tsawon dinki 3 mm, zaren da ya dace

say: A kasan ta dinka a fadin santimita 1 kasa da tashar zip, tare da dinkin mm 3.

Kada a taɓa yin ɗinki bisa haƙoran ƙarfe ko madaidaicin. Allurar na iya karya kuma ta tashi sama. Yi tafiya da injin da hannu kusa da tasha, sa gilashin idan kana da su, kuma ka mayar da fuskarka baya.

panel.heading: Ruth ta tsakiya zip, lafiya
items: Topstitch 7 mm kowane gefen kabu

Ketare 1 cm ƙasa da tashar zip
Tsawon dinki 3 mm, zaren da ya dace
panel.rule: Kada a taɓa ɗinke haƙoran ƙarfe ko tasha.

say: Misali, Joy a Calabar yana son maɓalli 7 akan rigar rigar da aka dace, na ƙarshe yana 42 cm ƙasa da na farko. Maɓallai bakwai suna yin sarari shida, don haka 42 da aka raba ta 6 shine 7 cm baya.

panel.heading: Murna ta sanya maɓallan rigar guda bakwai
items: 7 maɓalli = 6 sarari
42 cm / 6 = 7 cm tsakanin maɓalli
Layin tsatsa a 21 cm: maɓallin 4
Maɓallin 15 mm + 3 mm kauri = 18 mm rami
Fil a fadin iyakar kafin yanke

say: Layin bust ɗin ya faɗi ƙasa 21 cm ƙasa, daidai inda maɓallin 4 ya sauka, don haka rigar ba zata gape ba.

panel.heading: Murna ta sanya maɓallan rigar guda bakwai
items: 7 maɓalli = 6 sarari
42 cm / 6 = 7 cm tsakanin maɓalli
Layin tsatsa a 21 cm: maɓallin 4
Maɓallin 15 mm + 3 mm kauri = 18 mm rami
Fil a fadin iyakar kafin yanke

say: Maɓallanta sun kai mm 15 a fadin kuma kauri 3 mm, don haka kowane maɓalli yana da mm 18. Ƙarƙashin maɓalli a ƙarƙashin maɓalli kuma gwada ɗaya akan tarkace. Don buɗe shi, sanya fil a kowane ƙarshen, kuma yanke daga tsakiya zuwa waje.

panel.rule: Tsawon rami = diamita maballin + kauri. Sannan gwadawa.

say: Maɓallin lebur yana buƙatar guntun zaren, ɗan sarari don maɓalli na rami. Ba tare da shi ba, ƙullun ƙulli da zaren suna lalacewa. Yi amfani da zaren biyu, kuma sanya sandar ashana a saman maɓallin.

panel.heading: Dinka kowane maɓalli tare da shank
items: Zare biyu, ƙaramin ɗinki don farawa
Matchstick a saman maɓallin
A dinka shi sau 5 ko 6
Cire shi, kunsa zaren sau 4 ko 5
Ƙarshe da ƙananan dinki a baya

say: Dinka a kan sandar sau 5 ko 6. Cire shi, cire maɓallin sama, kuma kunsa zaren a ƙarƙashinsa sau 4 ko 5. Ƙarshe da ƙananan dinki a baya.
Don umarnin rukuni, wanke samfurin farko, kuma duba maɓallan har yanzu suna da ƙarfi.

say: Don tunawa. Sayi zips marasa ganuwa 2 zuwa 3 cm tsayi. Tsaya, danna coil, kuma dinka bangarorin biyu sama sama. Kada a taɓa yin ɗinki bisa haƙoran ƙarfe. Girman ramukan maɓalli daga maɓallin. Kuma a ba kowane maɓalli ɗan zaren zare.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: zip mara ganuwa 2 zuwa 3 cm tsayi
Tsaya, danna coil, dinka saman ƙasa
Kada a taɓa ɗinke haƙoran ƙarfe ko tasha
Hole = diamita na maɓalli + kauri
Kowane maballin ɗinki yana buƙatar shank

say: Yanzu yi samfurin zip marar ganuwa kuma auna yadda layin giciye ya hadu. Dinka zip ɗin da aka lakaɗa kuma auna abin saman. Sannan yi katin aikin rufewa tare da ramukan maɓalli, maɓallai masu tsinke, ƙugiya da mashaya da karye.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukanku na wannan tsarin
items: Samfurin zip marar ganuwa tare da layin giciye
Samfurin zip ɗin lapped, auna
